With the ridge mapper at its selected **k = 20**, the Llama 3.1 8B→70B transfer achieves:

- **MMLU: 57.78% accuracy**, against 78.84% for the 70B target running its own prefill (Table 13, p. 17). Table 1 reports this as **73.3% retention** (p. 6).
- **GSM8K: 14.78% accuracy**, against 81.12% for the 70B standalone (Table 13, p. 17). Table 1 reports this as **18.2% retention** (p. 6).

The transferred result is also below the 8B source model's own standalone scores of 64.97% on MMLU and 56.10% on GSM8K (Table 13, p. 17). The k = 20 setting is confirmed in Table 12 (p. 17).

Both benchmarks are well below this pair's 72.8% average retention (Table 1, p. 6). GSM8K was never used to choose k, so it is a held-out result (p. 6; Appendix H, p. 20).
